AutoOpen.Name: Auto-open on turn start
AutoOpen.Hint: Open the PF2e Combater panel when a combatant's turn starts.

CompactDefault.Name: Compact by default
CompactDefault.Hint: Open the panel in compact mode before any saved panel state exists.

RememberPanelPosition.Name: Remember panel position
RememberPanelPosition.Hint: Save the floating panel position on this client.

EnableSpellRecommendations.Name: Enable spell recommendations
EnableSpellRecommendations.Hint: Include curated spells in recommended full-turn plans.

HideUntrainedSkillActions.Name: Hide untrained skill actions
HideUntrainedSkillActions.Hint: Hide skill actions when the combatant is not trained in the required skill.

IncludeUnknownCustomActions.Name: Show unknown custom actions in alternatives
IncludeUnknownCustomActions.Hint: Show actor actions that PF2e Combater can detect but not tactically score.

HideAutoFillFromPlayers.Name: Hide Auto-fill from players
HideAutoFillFromPlayers.Hint: Remove the Auto-fill button for players so they plan their own turns instead of accepting the generic recommendation. The GM still sees Auto-fill.

ShowDebugTab.Name: Show GM debug tab
ShowDebugTab.Hint: Allow GMs to inspect scoring inputs, rejected actions, and detected actor actions.

DisableForPlayers.Name: Disable PF2e Combater for players
DisableForPlayers.Hint: Hide the panel and toolbar toggle from players entirely. The GM keeps full access.
